claim_text: He is told to go back to the 1960s and the Kennedy presidency: old ties are being reunited, alliances between Putin and Cuba around Havana are becoming stronger, and he sees secret things stationed in Cuba with Russia.
quote: I see stationed in Cuba, secret things in Cuba with Russia
falsify_match: Disclosure of Russian military or intelligence installations in Cuba after 7 January 2026.
falsify_miss: Nothing is disclosed. Russian signals facilities at Lourdes were reported in 2023 and 2024 and Russian warships visited Havana in June 2024, so the subject was public before the word; secret things is undefined and cannot fail.

claim_text: A red dawn experience is coming, an enemy within like a Trojan horse; many will think it is terrorist related but it is an act of war within, by people who infiltrated over the last four years of the previous administration.
quote: A red dawn experience is coming. The enemy within a Trojan horse
falsify_match: A coordinated attack inside America later attributed to foreign state actors who entered during 2021 to 2024.
falsify_miss: No such attack. Red dawn is his own label with no definition, so a single incident of any size could be claimed; the attribution to a foreign state rather than terrorism is the part that would have to be shown.

claim_text: With the Cuban grid dark and people moving at night, he sees a clear glass container with metal ends holding a pathogen from Russia being smuggled into America.
quote: it had some kind of pathogen in it that was from Russia
falsify_match: Interception of a biological agent entering the United States by way of Cuba, reported after this word.
falsify_miss: No interception and no outbreak traced that way. He has carried this since June 2025 with no date, and the container description cannot be checked unless a seizure is announced.

claim_text: Darkness comes on Cuba like a complete grid down, on purpose and in retaliation, because of the ties being made with Russia, though he says he does not know whether it is cyber.
quote: And I seen darkness on Cuba. Darkness. Like complete grid down
falsify_match: A total Cuban blackout shown to be deliberate rather than a plant failure.
falsify_miss: Cuba suffered repeated nationwide blackouts through 2024 and 2025 from its own ageing plants, so a blackout alone matches nothing. He hedges the cause himself by saying he does not know why.

claim_text: The mules left during the darkness under cover of night, in the middle of the night, while Cuba is being promised things, with great darkness there for Putin strategic allies.
quote: The mules left trying to be in the cover of night
time_phrase: in the middle of the night
falsify_match: Evidence that material or people were moved out of Cuba during a blackout.
falsify_miss: No such evidence. Mules is undefined and the movement is said to be hidden, which makes absence of reporting consistent with the claim rather than against it.

claim_text: He sees candles, gang lords and drug smugglers with great witchcraft wrapped into it, calls the religion there demonic and a stronghold, and says God wants to bring a river of his presence and revival all over Cuba.
quote: This is demonic religion there. It's a stronghold there
falsify_match: A reported revival movement in Cuba on a scale that draws coverage.
falsify_miss: Nothing measurable. Santeria practice in Cuba is well known and not a prediction, and a stronghold breaking has no observable form.

claim_text: Cuba and Venezuela are being promised things and lining up with Russia, and he says a Russian base that close to America would be very dangerous.
quote: it would be a base clear down there so strong being so close to America
falsify_match: A Russian military base established in Cuba.
falsify_miss: No base appears. Russia has not established a permanent base in Cuba since 2002 and is stretched in Ukraine, so the base rate is low, which would make this worth something if it landed.

claim_text: Cuba is offered a position in the BRICS with relief from Western tariffs and sanctions if it helps, brought into a new era of financing, and he sees submarines going to Cuba.
quote: Promising them a position in the bricks
falsify_match: Cuba admitted as a BRICS partner state with financing arrangements announced.
falsify_miss: Cuba had already been named a BRICS partner country at the Kazan summit in October 2024, so this describes something that had happened rather than something coming.

claim_text: A big Russian submarine is up out of the water heading toward Cuba on the east coast; he sees missiles in Cuba pointed at the United States, is shown Kennedy with Trump, hears the Kennedy curse, and is told a cold war will become even colder.
quote: it's headed towards Cuba and it's on the east coast
falsify_match: Russian missiles or a submarine deployment to Cuba reported after this word.
falsify_miss: No deployment. Russian naval visits to Havana occurred in 2023, 2024 and 2025 and were widely covered, so a port call would not be a match; missiles stationed in Cuba would be, and that has not happened since 1962.

claim_text: He says the previous administration allowed criminal things and that very evil people crossed the border over the past four years; he saw an enemy within America, strategic cells that would rise up and cause havoc, which is why he called it a red dawn.
quote: there was strategic cells in America that would rise up
falsify_match: A network of foreign cells activated inside the United States and charged as such.
falsify_miss: No activation. He has repeated this since October 2024 with no date and no city, so it cannot expire; arrests of individuals would not show a coordinated network.

claim_text: He saw Cuba tied into the Cold War alliances and a KGB spirit over Russia and Putin that would rise up in the days ahead, and a light purple lavender dragon coming up out of the Atlantic Ocean with dark fins.
quote: I saw a purple dragon coming up out of the Atlantic Ocean
falsify_match: He attaches the dragon to a named event that follows.
falsify_miss: A symbol with no stated referent. Nothing in the world could contradict a purple dragon, so this scores as unfalsifiable however events run.

claim_text: He says big money is being transferred by the cartel mules, asks prayer for border control to find the tunnels, and says there are many more tunnels all along the border from Texas to California.
quote: There's tunnels, tunnels, tunnels, tunnels all throughout the border
falsify_match: Discovery of multiple new cross-border tunnels after this word.
falsify_miss: Border tunnels are found and reported most years, with dozens documented since 1990, so discoveries would not distinguish a word from common knowledge.

claim_text: Cuba is highlighted, the water crystal clear, and it begins to glow and come alive with a spring of growth and leaves, with a line like an internet cord running from Cuba into Russia making Cuba alive.
quote: a line going from Cuba like like you would see like a internet cord
falsify_match: A Russian financial or communications lifeline to Cuba announced, followed by economic recovery there.
falsify_miss: Cuba stays in crisis. The glow and the sprout are imagery rather than events; only the Russian lifeline is checkable, and Russian credits to Havana have been reported repeatedly since 2023.

claim_text: As Cuba glows a new fountain of growth comes out of the middle of it, and he says to remember the Kennedy curse, that they try to bring it on Trump, and to remember the old alliances from the 1960s.
quote: Remember the Kennedy curse. They try to bring this on Trump
falsify_match: An attempt on the president tied to the Cuba situation.
falsify_miss: No attempt. The Kennedy curse is a frame rather than an event, and they try to bring it does not say it succeeds, so nothing here can fail.

claim_text: He sees chatter on the phone between Russia and Cuba providing the extension for financial freedom from America, and says they have underground bunkers under the island going back to the Cuban war, one like a silo under the ground near the water edge.
quote: They have like some underground bunkers underneath the island at Cuba
falsify_match: Disclosure of an underground military facility in Cuba near the coast.
falsify_miss: Nothing disclosed. Cuba built Soviet-era bunkers in the 1960s, which is common knowledge, so their existence is not the claim; something currently in them is.

claim_text: In the underground facility he sees again a device with a yellow hazard symbol with black on the side, alongside the purple dragon coming up three times out of the water by Cuba.
quote: it looks like a device with a yellow hazard symbol on the side
falsify_match: A nuclear or radiological device found in Cuba, reported after this word.
falsify_miss: No device is found. A hazard symbol is generic and covers chemical, biological and radiological labelling alike, so even a discovery would need to match more than the symbol.

claim_text: The device came from Russia in trade for something and is kept in a bunker in a cave under the island with little wires and a red antenna; there is only one of them, and one is all they need, stored there at Russia request.
quote: They got it from Russia for trade for something
falsify_match: Disclosure that Russia placed a single weapon in Cuban custody, or its use in retaliation.
falsify_miss: Nothing disclosed and nothing used. A single hidden object that only Russia and Cuba would know about is the least checkable form a weapon claim can take, and he adds no date.

claim_text: He saw attacks coming against America and old Cuban war alliances trying to bring a third world war greater than any before, with conventional weapons and missiles beyond the world wars that destroy masses of people.
quote: trying to bring forth a third world war greater than what we've ever seen
falsify_match: A general war involving America and the Russian bloc.
falsify_miss: No such war. He has warned of escalation to a third world war repeatedly since 2023 with no date, so the claim never expires and cannot be scored against a window.

claim_text: He says he is not cynical toward America and loves the country, prays for the president more than for anyone, and that as a watchman he tells what he sees when he sees storms coming.
quote: I'm a watchman and I tell you what I see
falsify_match: Nothing to match; this is a statement about his role.
falsify_miss: Nothing to miss. It is worth recording because it is the standard he asks to be judged by: a watchman who reports what he sees, which is a lower bar than a prophet who says what will be.

claim_text: The video is dedicated to praying for the president in the valley of decision he is in right now, with a storm and cliffs on both sides, and he is about to make a major decision.
quote: I saw him walking through this valley and he's about to make a major decision
falsify_match: A major presidential decision on Cuba reported within days of 6 January 2026.
falsify_miss: No decision follows. Every American president faces major decisions in any given week, so the base rate makes this near costless; the Cuba specification later in the same video is what gives it any weight.

claim_text: He recalls seeing Saving Private Ryan style scenes over Europe, and the Hitler symbol being called up through virgin sacrifices out of Berlin by witchcraft.
quote: the Hitler symbol being uh called up and through sacrifice through uh virgin sacrifices
falsify_match: Evidence of ritual activity in Berlin of the kind described, or a war in Europe on the scale he pictures.
falsify_miss: Nothing surfaces. Secret rituals are unobservable by construction, so this half can never fail; only the European war half is scoreable.

claim_text: He describes occult and demonic activity, channelling and conjuring through CERN and through portals by satanic practice, trying to bring forth the Hitler spirit and the Mahdi, which he says would be the antichrist.
quote: trying to conjure up the the through CERN through portals
falsify_match: No observable form. Nothing announced by CERN would confirm or deny a portal.
falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable as stated. He himself says he does not focus on darkness and only reports it, which is how the claim avoids carrying a cost.

claim_text: He sees a three strand cord that runs through Mexico, through Claudia and the drug cartels, and through Cuba in a V shape, with submarines and boats secretly delivering packages to Cuba at night, and says nothing is really secret from the United States at a hundred miles.
quote: a three- strand cord that goes through Mexico through Claudia and the drug cartels
falsify_match: Evidence of a Mexico to Cuba trafficking and payment chain involving the Mexican president.
falsify_miss: No evidence. The three strand cord is his own image, so any connection between the three would be read as the match; nothing has come out through August 2026.

claim_text: He has seen a storm coming out of Cuba, underground caverns dug there as bases holding military material and biological weapons, and how they could infiltrate and go after Miami and parts of the Florida Keys.
quote: underground uh bases like in Cuba that had um military stuff in it, biological weapons
falsify_match: An attack on Miami or the Keys traced to Cuba, or disclosure of a Cuban biological weapons store.
falsify_miss: Neither. Cuba has been accused of biological weapons research by American officials since 2002, so the accusation is not new; an actual attack on Miami is the part with a low base rate.

claim_text: He saw a glass cylinder like a bank teller tube with a symbol on the side, and the Lord showed him it coming out of Cuba and hitting the Miami side, not Tampa.
quote: the Lord showed me that coming out of Cuba, but it hit Miami side
falsify_match: A biological or chemical incident in Miami traced to Cuba.
falsify_miss: No incident. Naming Miami rather than Tampa is a real narrowing and would fail if the event happened elsewhere, but with no date attached it cannot expire.

claim_text: He saw liberation coming for Cuba and a green blade and spring of growth coming up out of it, with cords attached underwater like internet cords running to the Europe and Russia area, tied to a new spring of finances and freedom for Cubans.
quote: I saw a green blade coming up out of Cuba
falsify_match: Cuba liberated with a visible economic opening.
falsify_miss: No change in Cuba. A green blade is imagery with no threshold; he has told this sprout image since August 2025 and nothing has been attached to it since.

claim_text: He saw a major revival coming to Brazil, Venezuela, Cuba, Mexico and all of South America, and repeats that the valley of decision is concerning Cuba, who are in America backyard.
quote: I saw revival coming to Brazil, to Venezuela, to Cuba, to Mexico
falsify_match: Documented mass conversions across the named Latin American countries.
falsify_miss: Evangelical growth in Brazil and across Latin America has run for decades and is well documented, so the trend predates the word and almost any figure would be read as a match.

claim_text: He prays over rats in the military who infiltrated through the Biden administration and earlier ones, and says the CIA has a yellow hypnotic quill, yellow and black, that they will run as a broadcast across America in the days ahead.
quote: they're going to run that hypnoticquill and it's yellow and black
falsify_match: A national broadcast or alert of the kind he describes, with an official source.
falsify_miss: Nothing runs. Hypnotic quill is not a term with any referent, and he prefaces it by saying he is not into conspiracies, which is the hedge; there is no threshold at which this could be called wrong.

claim_text: He saw Kim Jong-un on the phone in a private meeting with Putin, Xi and Khamenei, all furious about Venezuela, devising a plan for how to infiltrate each piece of land they wanted, with Kim offered a lot.
quote: They were all talking and they were furious about Venezuela
falsify_match: A reported four way consultation between those leaders about Venezuela in early January 2026.
falsify_miss: No such meeting is reported. All four condemned the American action publicly, which was near certain, so only a private four way call would count as the match and that is not observable.

claim_text: He saw Xi trying to get the votes he needed in his own country, with people standing against invading Taiwan, and asks himself whether the number was three.
quote: There was people that were standing against invading Taiwan
falsify_match: Later disclosure of a split Chinese leadership vote on Taiwan in January 2026.
falsify_miss: Nothing surfaces. He hedges the number here by asking was it three, one day after giving three as a count, which is the sound of a detail being reconstructed rather than seen.

claim_text: He saw them weighing whether the risk of taking Taiwan was worth it, and in the vision they took Taiwan in two days, three days to totally take it, going in with special ops on helicopters, taking out the leadership as in Venezuela, with casualties on the ground and people fighting back.
quote: I saw in the vision they took Taiwan in two days
falsify_match: A Chinese decapitation operation against Taipei completed in two to three days.
falsify_miss: No invasion, or a longer campaign. Giving both two days and three days in one breath is how the earlier two day and three day tellings are reconciled after the fact; a helicopter assault across a hundred miles of strait is also a different operation from the Venezuela model he is copying it from.

claim_text: As Taiwan falls he sees a strategic plan to strike Israel at night with Turkey, Syria and the Brotherhood involved, using biological weapons in fifty gallon drums that looked like yellow liquid.
quote: Turkey, Syria were all involved. The Brotherhood
falsify_match: A night attack on Israel involving Turkish and Syrian forces with chemical or biological weapons.
falsify_miss: No attack. Turkey has not attacked Israel and the new Syrian government was seeking American sanctions relief at the time, so both would have to reverse; the fifty gallon drums are specific enough to fail cleanly.

claim_text: He saw the attack coming out of Egypt too with Israel surrounded on all sides, then a Jason Bourne style attack in which Zelensky is taken out and a proxy government put in that is pro Ukraine and pro Russia, and heard them say they can stretch him too thin so he must choose whom to save.
quote: I saw him being taken out and I saw a proxy government being put in
falsify_match: Zelensky removed and a government installed in Kyiv acceptable to Moscow.
falsify_miss: Zelensky remains. Taken out is left ambiguous between killed, ousted and voted out, which is the escape; he has carried this since August 2025.

claim_text: He saw a rubber band stretched and ready to break and a plan to escalate war so America is stretched too thin for the enemy within, calling it a red dawn experience and a D-Day.
quote: I saw like a rubber band that looked like it was ready to break
falsify_match: Simultaneous crises that force America to choose which ally to defend.
falsify_miss: Crises stay sequential. Stretched too thin is a judgement rather than an event and is said by commentators during every multi front period.

claim_text: He saw the opportunity for a Watergate scenario using social media, and major lawsuits coming against Elon Musk in the days ahead for huge sums over first amendment rights and shutting down freedom of speech in European nations using his platform.
quote: There'll be major lawsuits that will come against Elon Musk in the days ahead
falsify_match: New European lawsuits or fines against Musk or X for large sums after 6 January 2026.
falsify_miss: No new action. The European Commission had already opened DSA proceedings against X in December 2023 and fines were being reported through 2025, so pressure on Musk was public before the word; only the scale and the Watergate turn are his.

claim_text: The Lord says he is going after the Asians, and he saw a wave of glory on the hardest hearts and the greatest harvest of souls the world has ever seen, though he says it will not be everybody.
quote: I saw all the greatest harvest of souls this world has ever seen before
falsify_match: Global conversion figures exceeding any previous period, on a documented measure.
falsify_miss: No such figures. He concedes it will not be everybody, which removes any threshold, and the claim has been repeated since 2023 with no window.

claim_text: He sees a bloodline around Cornerstone in San Antonio because of that ministry stance with Israel, with local groups and one particular individual he calls an ISIS sympathizer who looks African American mixed.
quote: It's a bloodline around that church because he's standing with Israel
falsify_match: A foiled or attempted attack on that named San Antonio church.
falsify_miss: Nothing happens there. A named church, a named city and a single individual make this one of the few church warnings that could fail cleanly, and no date is attached, which is the only thing keeping it from expiring.

claim_text: He says there are layers of financial fraud on the land, that Elon was right about the one and a half trillion, and sees red arrows going out of Washington into banks and bank accounts in Ukraine.
quote: I see arrows that come out of Washington into Ukraine
falsify_match: An audit or indictment showing American money routed into private Ukrainian accounts.
falsify_miss: No such finding. Claims of misused Ukraine aid were already common in American political argument before this word, so the arrows add nothing that was not being said.

claim_text: He counts up to eight arrows coming out of accounts, so eight different people for sure are taking from it, and says the Lord told him not to forget the twenty four billion, which is in a digital vault.
quote: I count up to eight arrows coming out of accounts
falsify_match: Eight named people charged over diverted Ukraine funds, with a twenty four billion figure attached.
falsify_miss: No charges. The count of eight is the falsifiable part; if a scandal breaks with a different number of people it fails, and if none breaks the claim simply never resolves.

claim_text: He says the president put a kink in the hose concerning Venezuela in the BRICS, not a garden hose but a fire hose, cutting the financial flow, and that he sees the same coming with Cuba, then says he has said too much.
quote: He put a fire hose in bricks
falsify_match: A measurable drop in BRICS oil settlement traceable to Venezuela, and the same pattern repeated in Cuba.
falsify_miss: BRICS carries on unaffected. This is him reading the news of the strike back onto his own earlier phrase rather than saying anything new, three days after the event.

claim_text: He says it started on the third and they are already seeing it as the Lord said: Iran falling apart with protests and shooting, Venezuela in chaos, things in Israel and Ukraine, and Kim on the phone.
quote: Iran's falling apart. People are protesting, going crazy, burning things
falsify_match: Nothing forward is claimed here; it is a reading of events already in the news.
falsify_miss: He is scoring his own word against the headlines three days after the fact, which is what he elsewhere tells his audience not to do. It counts as a fulfilment assertion rather than evidence.

claim_text: He says the Lord told him they will desensitize people through media, then attack religion and freedom of speech under the name of hate speech, and that the greatest example of this will be seen this year in Canada and England.
quote: you'll see the greatest example of this this year in Canada and England
falsify_match: Speech prosecutions or religious restrictions in Canada and England during 2026 that are the most prominent instances of the year.
falsify_miss: Neither country produces a notable case in 2026. This is the dated form of the persecution thread and it does expire on 31 December 2026, which makes it stronger than the undated tellings; Britain was already arresting people over speech before he said it, so Canada carries the weight.

claim_text: A great press comes on the Canadian people with fresh oil and revival out of persecution, the same in Australia, where he sees a new young man rising who will take over and be bigger than Hillsong, with a little blonde girl named Lily singing new worship.
quote: a new young man rising up in Australia that will take over and be bigger
falsify_match: An Australian ministry led by a young man overtaking Hillsong in reach, with a singer named Lily.
falsify_miss: No such ministry appears. A first name and a comparison to a named institution make this one of the most checkable claims in the corpus, though bigger than Hillsong has no agreed measure and no date is given.

claim_text: He asks prayer over Italy for a major volcano about to go off, and says the Lord told him to watch for deep sea fish coming up on the Oregon coast as the sign that a major volcano is coming.
quote: watch the fish from the deep come up on Oregon's coast
falsify_match: Deep sea fish washing up on the Oregon coast, followed by a volcanic eruption off that coastline.
falsify_miss: Neither happens, or the fish appear without an eruption. Deep sea fish strandings on the Pacific coast are reported every few years and are usually explained by currents, so the sign alone would not carry it; naming a sign in advance is a real commitment and this can fail cleanly.

claim_text: He says a repeated vision is a major warning, and describes seeing twice a major poisoning of the water with fentanyl by the drug lords in retaliation, poisoning water plants in Louisiana, Alabama and that area, killing twenty three million people on the coast.
quote: a major poisoning of the water with fentanyl from the drug lords
falsify_match: An attack on southern water treatment plants using fentanyl, with mass casualties.
falsify_miss: No attack. Twenty three million dead would be a tenth of the region and beyond what fentanyl in treated water could do by dilution, which makes the number the weakest part; he gives no date, so it cannot expire.
